verses.text: In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.

xrefs.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth— the LORD alone, and His name alone.
“Comfort, comfort My people,” says your God.

verses.text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”

xrefs.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.

verses.text: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,

xrefs.text: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come! Let the one who hears say, “Come! And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
“For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug their own cisterns— broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.
For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’

verses.text: and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.

xrefs.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—

Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

verses.text: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.

xrefs.text: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
Go up on a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news. Raise your voice loudly, O Jerusalem, herald of good news. Lift it up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God!”
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!

verses.text: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

xrefs.text: “Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.
For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
Do not fear, O Jacob, you worm, O few men of Israel. I will help you,” declares the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
